project.name: oxiguitar-audio-alsa-plugin
project.description: The ALSA audio output plugin for OxiGuitar: plays guitar tablature and score sound through ALSA, Linux native sound system.

nodes.name: CI Pipeline
nodes.summary: Continuous integration pipeline: formatting, linting, testing across 6 platforms, license checks, and DCO sign-off verification. The ci-success job gates all merges to develop and main.
nodes.languageNotes: GitHub Actions workflow with matrix testing on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

nodes.name: Publish Workflow
nodes.summary: Triggers on release publication to send package artifacts to package repositories and winget via oxiguitar-packages reusable workflow. Requires PACKAGES_TOKEN and WINGET_TOKEN secrets.

nodes.name: Release Workflow
nodes.summary: Test builds on PRs and pushes to develop/main; draft releases on v* tags. Runs build-oxp.sh per target to produce zip, .deb, .rpm, and SHA256SUMS via oxiguitar-packages reusable workflow.

nodes.name: Changelog
nodes.summary: Keep a Changelog-formatted release history. Currently documents the initial v0.1.0 release splitting the plugin into its own repository.

nodes.name: Claude Working Rules
nodes.summary: Standing rules for AI-assisted development: library exactness, no telemetry, DCO compliance, branch strategy, and CI workflow conventions. References the OxiGuitar START-HERE.md as source of truth.

nodes.name: Contributing Guide
nodes.summary: Branch strategy (develop/main), pull request process, and DCO sign-off requirements. Bot commits (Claude, Dependabot) are exempt with maintainer review as human sign-off.

nodes.name: Cargo Manifest
nodes.summary: Rust package manifest for oxiguitar-audio-alsa-plugin v0.1.0. Depends on oxiguitar-plugin SDK and oxiguitar-audio-cpal from OxiGuitar repo tag v0.11.0. Linux-only with cpal ALSA host. Uses edition 2024, MSRV 1.99.

nodes.name: README
nodes.summary: Project overview: ALSA audio output plugin for OxiGuitar. Covers install, build/test instructions, history (split from oxiguitar repo at v0.11.0), and GPL-3.0 licensing.

nodes.name: Build OXP Script
nodes.summary: Builds the .oxp plugin file for the current system. Uses cargo rustc with --features oxp --crate-type cdylib. Outputs to dist/audio-alsa-VERSION-SYSTEM-ARCH.oxp. Linux-only.

nodes.name: Clippy Configuration
nodes.summary: Clippy linter settings: MSRV 1.99, permits unwrap/expect/panic/indexing only in test code.

nodes.name: Cargo Deny Configuration
nodes.summary: Dependency security and license policy: denies unknown registries and git sources, allows GPL-3.0 and other GPL-compatible licenses. Configures six build targets for license scanning.

nodes.name: Plugin Manifest
nodes.summary: OxiGuitar plugin metadata: interface 1.3, ID oxiguitar.audio-alsa, name ALSA audio, Linux-only. Declares audio-device service with id alsa, priority 10.

nodes.name: Rustfmt Configuration
nodes.summary: Rust formatter settings: edition 2024, max width 100, field init shorthand.

nodes.name: Dependabot Configuration
nodes.summary: Weekly version updates for Rust crates and GitHub Actions. Ignores oxiguitar-model, oxiguitar-plugin, oxiguitar-plugin-api, oxiguitar-plugin-test (pinned by git tag for frozen interface 1.4). DCO check script skips Dependabot commits.

nodes.name: PR Template
nodes.summary: Pull request template requiring: change description, test steps, test/docs/CHANGELOG updates, CREDITS.md updates, no test-corpus files, and DCO sign-off.

nodes.name: DCO Check Script
nodes.summary: Verifies every commit in a range has a DCO Signed-off-by line matching author email. Skips Claude app commits, Dependabot commits, and their squash merges. Used by CI's dco job.

nodes.name: Audio Plugin (ALSA)
nodes.summary: Core plugin implementation: the Audio struct implements Plugin and Service traits. Provides audio-device/alsa service through cpal's ALSA host (oxiguitar-audio-cpal). Exports via oxiguitar_plugin::export_plugin!. Linux-only via cfg gates.

nodes.name: Contract Test Suite
nodes.summary: Integration test that builds the .oxp file via oxiguitar_plugin_test::build() and validates it through OxiGuitar's plugin host via oxiguitar_plugin_test::check(). Linux-only.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Read the README to understand that oxiguitar-alsa is the ALSA audio output plugin for OxiGuitar — a guitar tablature viewer. It plays sound through ALSA, Linux's native sound system.

tour.title: Plugin Identity
tour.description: The manifest.json declares the plugin's identity: ID oxiguitar.audio-alsa, interface 1.3, providing the audio-device/alsa service. This is what OxiGuitar's plugin host looks for.

tour.title: Build System
tour.description: Cargo.toml defines the Rust crate with dependencies on the OxiGuitar plugin SDK and cpal audio library. build-oxp.sh compiles it into the .oxp plugin file.

tour.title: Core Plugin Implementation
tour.description: src/lib.rs is the heart of the project: the Audio struct implements Plugin::start() and Service traits, routing audio through cpal's ALSA host. It uses cfg gates for Linux-only compilation.

tour.title: Contract Testing
tour.description: tests/contract.rs builds the .oxp file and validates it through OxiGuitar's plugin host — the same process the app uses. This ensures the plugin meets the SDK contract.

tour.title: CI/CD Pipeline
tour.description: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs formatting, linting, testing on 6 platforms, license checks, and DCO verification. release.yml and publish.yml handle builds and distribution.

tour.title: Contributing
tour.description: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the branch strategy (develop/main), DCO sign-off process, and how pull requests are reviewed and merged.
